svg.title: Rust, extracted Lean 4, and the get_after theorem
svg.desc: Dark three-column code illustration. Rust adapts the calculator kernel with a h5i_app re-export and Result::map for the success branch. Rust and Lean use shorter parameter names. The Aeneas Lean definition uses shortened constructor names. The get_after statement retains all hypotheses; its proof excerpt explicitly omits the case analysis. Each column has at most twenty code lines.
